description: Get GYOTAK's full fish catalog with real-time availability, retail prices (THB/kg), freshness tiers, and traceability records. Retail prices are always included. For registered chat customers, pass customerKey (gyotak_cus_...) to show wholesale pricing and enable one-tap checkout. For LINE VIP customers, pass lineUserId. Delivery is available within Thailand only. International addresses are not accepted.

customerKey.description: GYOTAK customerKey (gyotak_cus_...) for registered chat customers — enables identification, wholesale pricing, and one-tap checkout (optional)

lineUserId.description: LINE user ID for VIP pricing (optional)

name: get_catalog

catalog.description: Used by the catalog widget (on-chain provenance per item)

items.description: Catalog lines in the order shown (empty when no stock)
One line of the catalog text

bands.description: Packs per weight band, as listed under 📦

catchRecordCount.description: Number of catch records in the traceability line

catchRecords.description: Up to 3 catch records as listed

days.description: Days tier shown next to the tier (LINE VIP order-page catalog only)

label.description: Card label shown in parentheses (LINE VIP order-page catalog only)

orderAs.description: Status and tier to pass to place_order, as shown after →

orderUpToKg.description: Shown as "order up to …kg"; 0 when shown as "cannot be ordered by kg right now"

priceOnRequest.description: true when the line shows "price on request"

priceThbPerKg.description: Price shown for this line (THB/kg). Retail for anonymous callers, the customer's own price when vip is present

section.description: Section heading (LINE VIP order-page catalog only)

tier.description: Fresh / Tier1 / Tier2, or "all" for lines listed as [all tiers]

weightKg.description: Stock weight as shown (kg, one decimal)

vip.description: Customer line shown for a registered customer

orderMode.description: LINE VIP order-page catalog: catalog browsing only / order from the LINE VIP order page / order in this chat

shippingZone.description: "0" = local (free), otherwise the zone number shown

tierPricing.description: true when shown as "tier pricing applied"
